run_hydra_app: run a Hydra-decorated Python app that prints the resolved config as YAML
run_my_app: run the my_app function to print the Hydra config in YAML format
create_hydra_app: create a Python app using @hydra.main to load and print a YAML config
review_my_app: review the my_app function that uses @hydra.main and OmegaConf.to_yaml
refactor_my_app: refactor the my_app function to add custom logic beyond printing the config
